user.title: Mercedes Trips
user.description: Logs every trip of your Mercedes from the Mercedes me (mbapi2020) entities. If that integration is set up, its entities are already selected below.

data_description.odometer_entity: The car's odometer, e.g. `sensor.…_odometer` from Mercedes me (mbapi2020). Trips start and end on its changes.
data_description.tracker_entity: The car's device_tracker, used for the route and the start/end addresses.
data_description.soc_entity: State of charge in %, used to work out the energy each trip used.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable (net) capacity of your car's battery. See the table in the README if you don't know it.
data_description.inactivity_timeout_min: A trip ends after this many minutes without the odometer changing.
data_description.min_trip_distance_km: Shorter trips are discarded as GPS/odometer noise.

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found in Home Assistant

abort.already_configured: Mercedes Trips is already set up
abort.single_instance_allowed: Mercedes Trips is already set up; it logs one car per Home Assistant.
